data.name: Ruqqayah
data.gender_notes: Ruqqayah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman with a beautiful garden, orchard or grove. The name Ruqqayah carries the meaning “Garden, orchard, grove” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ruqqayah usually hope their child will grow to embody garden, orchard, grove and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who nurtures and cares for her inner and outer self, like a garden that blooms with love and self-care.
data.etymology: Ruqqayah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden, orchard, grove.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruqqayah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: رقية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الرفعة و العلو في المعنى و المكانة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رقية مشتق من رَقِيَ يَرقَى رُقِيًّا فهو راقٍ و رقية، و منه قوله تعالى: ﴿وَمَا أَنْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ إِلَّا إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا ﴾ سورة الفرقان آية 20، و رقية تعني الرفعة في المكانة و العلو في المعنى

in_urdu.name: رقیہ
in_urdu.meaning: وہ نام جو اچھے معنی اور بلند مقام کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رقیہ نام کا مطلب ہے بلندیاں، اچھائی، اور خوبی ۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جس کی بنیادی جڑ 'رقی' ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'اٹھنا' یا 'بلند ہونا' ۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، رقیہ ایک ایسا نام ہے جو روحانی ترقی اور دینی علم کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: रुक्कया
in_hindi.meaning: यह नाम अच्छे अर्थ और उच्च स्थान की ओर संकेत करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: रुक्कया नाम का अर्थ है उच्चता, अच्छाई और सुंदरता । यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जिसकी मूल जड़ 'रुक़ी' है जिसका अर्थ है 'उंचाई' या 'बढ़ना' । इस्लामी परंपरा में, रुक्कया एक ऐसा नाम है जो आध्यात्मिक उन्नति और धार्मिक ज्ञान के महत्व को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: رقيه
in_pashto.meaning: دغه نوم د ښو مانا او لوړ مقام ښودنه کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: رقيه نوم د (رقی) څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده لوړی، ښایست، او نیکۍ . په اسلامي کلیو کې، دغه نوم د معنوي ودې او مذهبي پوهې د اهمیت ښودنه کوي

in_english.name: Ruqqayah
in_english.meaning: A name indicating good meaning and high status
in_english.long_meaning: Ruqqayah is derived from the Arabic root 'رَقِيَ' (ra-qī) meaning 'to rise' or 'to ascend'. In Islamic tradition, Ruqqayah symbolizes spiritual elevation, nobility, and high esteem. Historically, it was borne by Ruqqayah bint Muhammad, a respected figure in Islamic history. The name embodies virtues of ascension, moral excellence, and divine favor

data.cultural_impact: The name Ruqqayah in the Islamic world evokes images of beauty, creativity, and sustainability. The name suggests a woman with a beautiful garden or orchard, which speaks to the esteemed value and importance of nature in Islamic culture. In many Muslim countries, gardens, especially those with fruit-bearing trees, are considered symbols of prosperity, peace, and tranquility. The name Ruqqayah could be seen as a reminder of the importance of tending to the natural world, as well as a representation of the abundant blessings that nature bestows upon us.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Ruqqayah can be seen as a reminder of the notion of cultivation and growth in the Islamic tradition. just as a garden needs constant tending and care to produce fruit, so too do we need to tend to our spiritual lives in order to grow and prosper. The name can also be seen as a reference to the hadith of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), which states, "The best of you is the one who is best to his family, and I am the best of you to my family." In this light, Ruqqayah can be seen as a reflection of the ideal Muslim woman, who not only takes care of her own spiritual growth but also nurtures and fosters the growth of her family and community.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Garden, orchard, grove" symbolizes A woman with a beautiful garden, orchard or grove. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ruqqayah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of garden, orchard, grove.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ruqqayah bint Muhammad ibn 'Abd Allah ibn 'Abd al-Muttalib (d. 624) The name Ruqqayah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Daughter of the Prophet Muhammad and Khadijah bint Khuwaylid. She is considered the first female convert to Islam and the first wife of the Prophet.
